capabilities: Pinch or wheel to zoom without text reflow
Hold a key or long-press for a loupe magnifier
Pan the zoomed note across its full extent
Reset zoom to 100% via Esc, pill, or gesture
Configure zoom speed, magnification, and loupe
extras: Renamed in 1.2.0 from 'Optical Pinch-to-Zoom & Loupe Magnifier' (id obsidian-optical-zoom) to Optical Zoom (id optical-zoom); settings reset to defaults after switching. Runs 100% locally with no network calls or telemetry.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in zoom changes font size and reflows text. This plugin instead scales the already-rendered note surface
problem: Obsidian's built-in zoom changes font size and reflows text, so formulas, diagrams, tables, and dense scripts don't scale cleanly.

relations.evidence: You can also install and auto-update via the BRAT plugin by adding this repository
canvas content (Excalidraw, charts) is copied across

summary: GPU-accelerated zoom and loupe magnifier that scales the rendered note without text reflow, via pinch, wheel, or a hold-key lens.
